title: Estimating Time Since Death: Why Single Signs Mislead
subject: Forensic Medicine
preview: Algor, livor and rigor mortis are postmortem phenomena, but their timing varies with environment and circumstances.
quickRevision: Algor, livor and rigor mortis are postmortem phenomena, but their timing varies with environment and circumstances.
Forensic time-since-death estimates require integration of multiple observations and scene context.
Single textbook timelines are poor substitutes for case-specific forensic assessment.

sections.title: Recognize the core pattern
points: Algor, livor and rigor mortis are postmortem phenomena, but their timing varies with environment and circumstances.
Body temperature, clothing, location, body habitus and movement can affect decomposition signs.

sections.title: Clinical examination and interpretation
points: Forensic time-since-death estimates require integration of multiple observations and scene context.
Single textbook timelines are poor substitutes for case-specific forensic assessment.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Do not claim a precise time of death from one isolated sign.

quiz.question: Which factor materially affects postmortem cooling?
quiz.explanation: Ambient temperature. Body temperature, clothing, location, body habitus and movement can affect decomposition signs.
